subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should the project adopt this bounded model/source share-card contract after its renderer and partial-history prerequisites land, or keep the share artifact on the existing provider-oriented contract?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing narrative and aggregation contract while the related product-design and model-identity discussions remain open; code review cannot determine which artifact contract maintainers want to support long term.

options.title: Adopt after hardening
options.body: Keep the design direction, land the renderer and partial-history prerequisites first, then rebase this PR with truthful date and coverage behavior.

options.title: Keep the existing contract
options.body: Pause this prototype and retain the current provider-oriented share card until a maintainer-approved aggregation contract is defined.

recommendation.title: Adopt after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep the design direction, land the renderer and partial-history prerequisites first, then rebase this PR with truthful date and coverage behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The related owner-authored partial-history work and shared data path make steipete the strongest available decision route.
